title: Credentials reachable by Board disciplinary action
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 10.01 the Board may take disciplinary action against a registered pharmacist, a pharmacy technician, a pharmacy, a pharmacy department, a wholesale licence, and a controlled substance registration issued by the Board. Under 247 CMR 10.03(1) the Board may impose disciplinary action on the grounds listed in M.G.L. c. 112, § 61 or on the grounds listed in 247 CMR 10.03, and under 247 CMR 10.03(2) nothing in that section limits the Board's adoption of policies and grounds for discipline through adjudication as well as through rulemaking.
exam_relevance: Tests that the Board's disciplinary reach extends across individual and entity credentials and that the listed grounds are not exhaustive.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The enumerated grounds are not a closed list; M.G.L. c. 112, § 61 grounds also apply.
One incident can expose both the individual and the pharmacy credential.
verification_notes: Read verbatim in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 10.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-B authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
